description: Defines output data classes for verified phone resources, including individual and list responses for users and teams, with validation and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: UserVerifiedPhoneOutputData
classes.description: Data class representing a verified phone for a user, including ID, phone number, and optional user ID.

classes.name: TeamVerifiedPhoneOutputData
classes.description: Data class representing a verified phone for a team, including ID, phone number, optional user ID, and team ID.

classes.name: UserVerifiedPhoneOutput
classes.description: Response class indicating status and data for a single user's verified phone.

classes.name: TeamVerifiedPhoneOutput
classes.description: Response class indicating status and data for a team's verified phone.

classes.name: UserVerifiedPhonesOutput
classes.description: Response class for a list of verified phones for users, including status and array of data objects.

classes.name: TeamVerifiedPhonesOutput
classes.description: Response class for a list of verified phones for teams, including status and array of data objects.
